item.title: Bob Weir, Grateful Dead Co‑Founder, Dies at 78
item.description: Bob Weir, a founding member of the Grateful Dead and a central figure in the band’s long history, has died at 78. His death marks the end of a career that helped define one of the most influential groups in American music and shaped the sound of several generations of live performers. No cause of […]
